name: livechat
description: Premium multi-tenant live chat platform: embeddable widget, CSR dashboard, calls, secure file sharing

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,dashboard,widget -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/dashboard" "npm run watch -w apps/widget"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/widget && npm run build -w apps/dashboard && npm run typecheck -w apps/server
